title: Micro-Kernel ServiceContext Typed Key Provider Contract & Singleton Export
author: deep-repo-auditor

claims.assertion: Every plugin implementation entrypoint (plugins/<category>/<name>/main.py) must explicitly export an instantiated module-level singleton `plugin = MyPlugin()`.
Service registration requires context.provide(ServiceKey[T], instance) and resolution requires context.require(ServiceKey[T]), strictly prohibiting raw strings.
The lifecycle manager topologically sorts plugin dependencies based on declared provides and requires properties prior to staging sandboxes or activation.
